content: .{@-गर्भ@} {%a.%} [अग्निर्गर्भे यस्य] pregnant with or containing fire, having fire in the interior; ˚र्भां शमीमिव <ls>Ś. 4. 3</ls>. ({@-र्भः@}) [अग्निरिव जारको गर्भो यस्य] .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the plant Agnijāra. .²2 the sun stone, name of a crystal supposed to contain and give out fire when touched by the rays of the sun; <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ś. 2. 7</ls>. .²3 the sacrificial stick अरणि which when churned, gives out fire. . ({@-र्भा@}) .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of the Śamī plant as containing fire (the story of how Agni was discovered to exist in the interior of the Śamī plant is told in <ab>chap.</ab> 35 of अनुशासनपर्व in <ls>Mb.</ls>). .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of the earth (अग्नेः सकाशात् गर्भो यस्यां सा; when the Ganges threw the semen of Śiva out on the Meru mountain, whatever on earth <ab>&c.</ab> was irradiated by its lustre, became gold and the earth was thence called वसुमती) .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of the plant महाज्योतिष्मती लता (अग्निरिव गर्भो मध्यभागो यस्याः सा) [<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>मालकांगोणी</ns>]
